scope: Deterministic actuator mocks; no physical controller or wheel verification.
checks: Eight event patterns produce bounded distinct dual-rumble traces, reject duplicate triggers, finish cleanly and include stronger completion than waypoint feedback.
Simultaneous rewards cap at 12 segments; stalled device promises cap at 2, and stopping clears both pending patterns and hardware output.
Continuous NOS remains active at a bounded send rate; pause and disabled feedback immediately cancel new event patterns as well as continuous vibration.
Damaged rotating wheels add a changing wobble pattern while healthy coasting and a damaged parked car stay quiet.
Input event forwarding obeys active driving, visibility and the user feedback setting; menus cannot leave accidental rumble running.
Visible menu waypoint, purchase and objective cues have a 0.5 s deadline and never inherit driving NOS/ABS; clear, hidden focus and blur cancel them.
